limitations: Scenario screening only: no inference of fraud, money laundering, criminal intent, ownership, sanctions status or legal breach.

TF001 uses the maximal retrospective 60-minute inflow window at each distinct incoming instant, followed by the earliest qualifying outgoing prefix ending within 60 minutes of its oldest included inflow; it does not search every possible subset.
Windows can overlap and reuse records. Amount relationships do not trace fungible funds or establish that the same money returned.
Legitimate merchant settlements, treasury operations and other ordinary activity can match. A no-alert report does not establish that activity is safe.

Input order is normalized by timestamp instant then ID. Equal timestamps cannot establish a subsequent phase or leg. Currency codes are syntax-checked only; no exchange conversion or registry lookup is performed.

Only the supplied extract is evaluated. Missing, delayed, reversed or unrecorded transfers, account ownership and external context are not inferred. Monetary evidence is exact decimal strings in integer minor units.

policy.threshold_basis: Arbitrary synthetic-lab policy, not a legal or regulatory threshold.
